news.headline: Travis Etienne will not play Monday night
news.summary: Coach Kellen Moore said Etienne is out against Atlanta because of his hurt hamstring. Alvin Kamara will be the main running back, with Kendre Miller and rookie C.J. Donaldson helping.

news.headline: The league explains the fumble that turned Sunday's game
news.summary: Tyler Shough lost the ball in the fourth quarter, Las Vegas picked it up, and the Raiders scored the touchdown that put them ahead. The league's replay boss said the ball came loose before Shough's arm moved forward, so it was a fumble, and Shough said he thought he had thrown it.

news.headline: Raiders beat the Saints 35-27 in the home opener
news.summary: Tyler Shough threw four touchdown passes Sunday in the Superdome, and all four went to tight ends. The Saints then lost the ball four times in the fourth quarter and dropped to 1-2.

news.headline: Jadan Baugh wins the top offensive award in the SEC
news.summary: The conference named Baugh its offensive player of the week after he ran for 142 yards and three touchdowns against Ole Miss. Two more Gators were honored: London Montgomery on special teams and Bryce Lovett on the offensive line.

news.headline: Vernell Brown is expected to play at Missouri
news.summary: Tests on the knee Brown hurt Saturday came back clean, and coach Jon Sumrall said the news was great and he could be back this week. Eric Singleton, who missed two games with a sprained ankle, will practice fully.

news.headline: Florida jumps to No. 8 in the new rankings
news.summary: The Gators moved up 13 spots in the Associated Press poll after beating Ole Miss 52-28 on Saturday. It is the first time Florida has been in the top 10 in five years.

news.headline: Whit Weeks breaks his leg and is out indefinitely
news.summary: The LSU linebacker broke his lower right leg in Saturday's win over Texas A&M and left the field on crutches. Coach Lane Kiffin said Weeks will be out a long while but may still come back late in the season.

news.headline: Deuce Geralds is the SEC freshman of the week
news.summary: The conference gave its weekly freshman award to the LSU defensive tackle for his part in Saturday's 35-6 win over Texas A&M. He is the only LSU player honored this week.

news.headline: LSU is No. 11 in the new rankings
news.summary: The Tigers are 11th in the Associated Press poll after beating Texas A&M 35-6 on Saturday. They host McNeese on Saturday night in Baton Rouge.

nextGame.note: Tulane has a bye this coming Saturday.

news.headline: Maurice Turner wins the conference weekly award
news.summary: Turner carried the ball 12 times for 200 yards and two touchdowns in Saturday's 24-21 win over Southern Miss, including the 74-yard run that put Tulane ahead. It is the first weekly honor of his career.

news.headline: Tulane wins the Battle for the Bell 24-21
news.summary: Maurice Turner ran for 200 yards Saturday at Yulman Stadium, and his 74-yard touchdown run with 5:26 left put Tulane ahead. TJ Smith then blocked a Southern Miss field goal to save the win for coach Will Hall against his old team.

news.headline: Jamauri McClure misses another game
news.summary: Tulane's running back will sit out Saturday's game against Southern Miss with a foot injury, and he has not played at all this season. The Green Wave have a bye next week and hope he can come back October 10 at Army.
